newsitem.title: USA: Micronics sees Q4 revs below estimates.
newsitem.headline: Micronics sees Q4 revs below estimates.

text.p: Micronics Computers Inc said Thursday its revenues for the fourth quarter ending September 30 will range between $38 and $41 million, well below the $45 to $50 million it had previously estimated.

"The strong rebound in government channel sales that we expected has not materialized" due to uncertainty over budgeted funds, Shanker Munshani, chief executive said in a statement. He also noted a general slowdown in purchasing on government contracts due to budget uncertainty.
Micronics said it is actively pursuing new customers and offering advanced technology products for future growth.
"We are reorganizing our sales and marketing staff to work more closely with customers in higher margin market segments," the company said.
Micronics also said it is bringing in "outside skills" and developing new technologies to boost its prospects.
Micronics will report its fourth quarter and fiscal year-end 1996 results on October 28, 1996.
